convert_atoms_to_ase: convert an Atoms dataclass to an ASE Atoms object with cell, positions, and FixAtoms constraints
convert_relaxation_result_to_ase: convert an AdsorbateSlabRelaxationResult to an ASE Atoms object with SinglePointCalculator for energy and forces
deserialize_adsorbate_slab_relaxations_r: deserialize a JSON payload into an AdsorbateSlabRelaxationsRequest dataclass for submitting adsorbate slab relaxation jobs
check_relaxation_status: use the Status enum to check if a relaxation result is SUCCESS, FAILED_RELAXATION, NOT_AVAILABLE, or DOES_NOT_EXIST
deserialize_slabs_response: deserialize a JSON response into a Slabs dataclass containing a list of Slab objects with atoms and metadata
